newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys Jan/Feb reformate at $25.50-$26.00/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys Jan/Feb reformate at $25.50-$26.00/bbl.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has only bought through a tender 500,000 barrels of 95-octane unleaded reformate for January-February delivery at $25.50-$26.00 per barrel due to high prices, a company official said on Tuesday.
"The price was not so good," said the official. "We may emerge tomorrow with more requirements for February."
CPC normally buys two to three cargoes in one tender depending on the price, traders said.
He said there were over 12 offers for the tender which closed on December 16 and was valid for two days.

CPC bought one 250,000-barrel cargo for delivery on January 18-27 at $26.00 per barrel and one for February 11-20 delivery at $25.50 per barrel, both on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Taichung.
In its last tender, CPC bought one cargo of unleaded reformate from a European major at around $26.80 per barrel, c-and-f Taiwan for delivery January 1-15.
